gl.sales_revenue.name: Sales Revenue
gl.sales_revenue.definition: Σ(credit − debit) on accounts with role = sales_revenue, non-reversed, by je.date

gl.income.name: Total Income
gl.income.definition: Σ(credit − debit) on type = income, non-reversed, by je.date

gl.cogs.name: Cost of Goods Sold
gl.cogs.definition: Σ(debit − credit) on role = cogs, non-reversed, by je.date

gl.opex.name: Operating Expenses
gl.opex.definition: Σ(debit − credit) on type = expense and role ≠ cogs, by je.date

gl.cash_in.name: Cash Inflow
gl.cash_in.definition: Σ debit on role ∈ {cash, bank} lines of non-internal transfer entries

gl.cash_out.name: Cash Outflow
gl.cash_out.definition: Σ credit on role ∈ {cash, bank} lines of non-internal transfer entries

gl.balance_cash.name: Cash Balance
gl.balance_cash.definition: Closing balance of accounts with role = cash

gl.balance_bank.name: Bank Balance
gl.balance_bank.definition: Closing balance of accounts with role = bank

gl.balance_ar.name: Accounts Receivable Balance
gl.balance_ar.definition: Closing balance of accounts with role = ar

gl.balance_ap.name: Accounts Payable Balance
gl.balance_ap.definition: Closing balance of accounts with role = ap

gl.balance_tax_output.name: Tax Output Balance
gl.balance_tax_output.definition: Closing balance of accounts with role = tax_output

gl.balance_tax_input.name: Tax Input Balance
gl.balance_tax_input.definition: Closing balance of accounts with role = tax_input

gl.balance_equity.name: Total Equity Balance
gl.balance_equity.definition: Sum of equity account balances plus retained earnings

gl.journal_count.name: Journal Entries Count
gl.journal_count.definition: Count of non-reversed journal entries in window

gl.reversal_count.name: Reversal Entries Count
gl.reversal_count.definition: Count of reversal journal entries in window

gl.trial_balance_ok.name: Trial Balance Check
gl.trial_balance_ok.definition: Verification that debits equal credits and books balance

gl.owner_drawings.name: Owner Drawings
gl.owner_drawings.definition: Debits to equity from owner drawing reference types

gl.sale_returns_value.name: Sales Returns Ledger Value
gl.sale_returns_value.definition: Σ debit to sales_revenue on sale_return entries

gl.sale_returns_count.name: Sales Returns Ledger Count
gl.sale_returns_count.definition: Count of non-reversed sale_return journal entries

gl.supplier_payments_paid.name: Supplier Payments Paid
gl.supplier_payments_paid.definition: Σ AP debits on purchase_payment journal entries

gl.customer_receipts_collected.name: Customer Receipts Collected
gl.customer_receipts_collected.definition: Σ AR credits on receipt payment entries

sales.net_revenue.name: Sales Net Revenue
sales.net_revenue.definition: Σ sales.net_sales, status ∈ REVENUE_RECOGNISED, original_sale_id IS NULL

sales.pos_revenue.name: POS Counter Revenue
sales.pos_revenue.definition: Σ net_sales where source = pos and status recognised

sales.pos_count.name: POS Counter Sale Count
sales.pos_count.definition: Count recognised sales where source = pos

sales.pos_max_sale.name: POS Max Sale Amount
sales.pos_max_sale.definition: MAX(net_sales) on counter sales in window

sales.pos_discount_total.name: POS Discounts Total
sales.pos_discount_total.definition: Σ total_item_discounts + global_discount on recognised sales

sales.invoicing_revenue.name: Invoice Sales Value
sales.invoicing_revenue.definition: Σ invoice_total of recognised sales where source = manual and ecommerce_channel_id IS NULL

sales.invoicing_count.name: Invoice Sales Count
sales.invoicing_count.definition: Count recognised sales where source = manual and ecommerce_channel_id IS NULL

sales.invoicing_unpaid_value.name: Unpaid Invoices Value
sales.invoicing_unpaid_value.definition: Σ (invoice_total − payment_allocations) on open recognised invoices

sales.invoicing_overdue_value.name: Overdue Invoices Value
sales.invoicing_overdue_value.definition: Open balance on invoices where due_date < today

sales.invoicing_overdue_count.name: Overdue Invoices Count
sales.invoicing_overdue_count.definition: Count of open invoices with due_date < today

sales.customers_active.name: Active Customers Count
sales.customers_active.definition: Count of distinct customer parties on recognised sales in window

sales.customers_new.name: New Customers Count
sales.customers_new.definition: Count of customers whose first recognised sale falls in window

sales.by_tier_revenue.name: Revenue By Pricing Tier
sales.by_tier_revenue.definition: Net revenue grouped by customer pricing tier

sales.busiest_day.name: Busiest Day Revenue
sales.busiest_day.definition: Day in window with maximum sales net revenue

sales.peak_hour.name: Peak Sales Hour
sales.peak_hour.definition: Hour of day (0-23) with maximum net sales in window

sales.document_sequence_ok.name: Document Sequences Integrity Check
sales.document_sequence_ok.definition: Verification of no gaps or duplicates in sale reference numbers

sales.services_revenue.name: Services Revenue
sales.services_revenue.definition: Σ sale_items.net_amount for products with type = service

purchases.spend.name: Purchase Spend Total
purchases.spend.definition: Σ purchases.total, workflow_status posted/received in window

purchases.count.name: Purchase Count
purchases.count.definition: Count of posted/received purchases in window

purchases.overdue_value.name: Overdue Purchases Value
purchases.overdue_value.definition: Open balance on purchases where due_date < today

purchases.debit_notes_approved.name: Debit Notes Approved Value
purchases.debit_notes_approved.definition: Σ debit_notes.amount where status IN (pending, approved)

purchases.ingredient_costs.name: Ingredient Purchase Costs
purchases.ingredient_costs.definition: Weighted unit cost of recipe ingredients on purchase lines

stock.value_fifo.name: FIFO Stock Valuation
stock.value_fifo.definition: Σ remaining_qty × unit_cost on inventory_batches where deleted_at IS NULL

stock.dead_stock_value.name: Dead Stock FIFO Value
stock.dead_stock_value.definition: FIFO value of products with stock > 0 and no sale line in last 90 days

stock.batches_expiring_30_count.name: Batches Expiring in 30 Days Count
stock.batches_expiring_30_count.definition: Count batches with remaining_qty > 0 and expiry_date <= 30 days

stock.batches_expiring_30_value.name: Batches Expiring in 30 Days Value
stock.batches_expiring_30_value.definition: Σ remaining_qty × unit_cost for batches expiring within 30 days

party.ar_balances.name: Party Accounts Receivable Balances
party.ar_balances.definition: Per-party AR balance from ledger journal items

party.ap_balances.name: Party Accounts Payable Balances
party.ap_balances.definition: Per-party AP balance from ledger journal items

party.over_limit_count.name: Customers Over Credit Limit Count
party.over_limit_count.definition: Count of parties whose AR balance exceeds their credit_limit

party.over_limit_list.name: Customers Over Credit Limit List
party.over_limit_list.definition: Parties whose AR balance exceeds credit limit

payments.receipts_total.name: Payment Receipts Total
payments.receipts_total.definition: Σ payments.amount where type = in and date in window

payments.payouts_total.name: Payment Payouts Total
payments.payouts_total.definition: Σ payments.amount where type = out and date in window

payments.pos_tender_breakdown.name: POS Counter Tenders Breakdown
payments.pos_tender_breakdown.definition: Σ payments.amount by method on counter sales in window

expenses.landed_cost_total.name: Landed Cost Total
expenses.landed_cost_total.definition: Σ expenses.amount where is_landed_cost = 1 in window

doc.quotations_open_value.name: Open Quotations Value
doc.quotations_open_value.definition: Σ total_amount where status = sent and valid_until >= today

doc.sales_orders_count.name: Sales Orders Count
doc.sales_orders_count.definition: Count sales_orders with order_date in window

doc.sales_orders_open_count.name: Open Sales Orders Count
doc.sales_orders_open_count.definition: Count sales_orders status NOT IN (draft, cancelled, completed, delivered)

doc.sales_orders_open_value.name: Open Sales Orders Value
doc.sales_orders_open_value.definition: Σ total_amount on open sales orders

doc.po_open_value.name: Open Purchase Orders Value
doc.po_open_value.definition: Σ total_amount for purchase orders status IN (ordered, partial)

doc.po_pending_receipt_value.name: Purchase Orders Pending Receipt Value
doc.po_pending_receipt_value.definition: Σ (qty − received_qty) × unit_cost on open PO lines

doc.transfers_pending_value.name: Pending Stock Transfers Value
doc.transfers_pending_value.definition: Σ qty × current FIFO cost for pending transfers

doc.stocktakes_variance_value.name: Stocktakes Variance Value
doc.stocktakes_variance_value.definition: Σ difference × cost_price on completed stocktakes in window

doc.parked_sales_open_count.name: Open Parked Sales Count
doc.parked_sales_open_count.definition: Count occupancies source_type = parked_sale, closed_at IS NULL

doc.parked_sales_open_value.name: Open Parked Sales Value
doc.parked_sales_open_value.definition: Σ cart total parsed from open parked occupancy session_data

doc.tables_occupied_count.name: Occupied Restaurant Tables Count
doc.tables_occupied_count.definition: Count occupancies closed_at IS NULL on table positions (excl parked)

doc.recurring_monthly_value.name: Recurring Invoices Monthly Value
doc.recurring_monthly_value.definition: Σ items total × frequency factor for active recurring invoices

doc.proposals_count.name: B2B Proposals Count
doc.proposals_count.definition: Count proposals with date in window

doc.proposals_pipeline_value.name: Proposals Pipeline Value
doc.proposals_pipeline_value.definition: Σ total_amount for proposals status sent/draft not expired

master.gift_card_balance.name: Gift Cards Active Balance
master.gift_card_balance.definition: Σ current_balance on active unexpired gift cards

attendance.on_shift_count.name: Staff On Shift Now Count
attendance.on_shift_count.definition: Attendance rows with check_in today and check_out NULL

attendance.hours_worked.name: Total Staff Hours Worked
attendance.hours_worked.definition: Σ total worked hours in window

production.total_cost.name: Production Runs Total Cost
production.total_cost.definition: Σ total_cost of runs completed in window

production.output_qty.name: Production Actual Output Qty
production.output_qty.definition: Σ actual_qty for completed runs in window

stock.catalogue_value.name: Stock Retail Catalogue Value
stock.catalogue_value.definition: Σ stock qty × product retail price

stock.batches_total_qty.name: Total Quantity in Batches
stock.batches_total_qty.definition: Σ remaining_qty on batches with expiry tracking

master.barcodes_duplicate_count.name: Duplicate Barcodes Count
master.barcodes_duplicate_count.definition: Count barcodes appearing on multiple products

master.barcodes_missing_count.name: Products Missing Barcode Count
master.barcodes_missing_count.definition: Count goods products without active barcode

master.uom_count.name: Units of Measure Count
master.uom_count.definition: Count distinct units used by products

master.uom_missing_conversion_count.name: Products Missing UOM Conversion Count
master.uom_missing_conversion_count.definition: Count products with secondary unit but missing conversion

doc.kitchen_pending_orders_count.name: Kitchen Pending Orders Count
doc.kitchen_pending_orders_count.definition: Count work orders in kitchen not yet bumped

doc.marketplace_sync_errors_count.name: Marketplace Sync Errors Count
doc.marketplace_sync_errors_count.definition: Count failed sync items and channel errors

master.plan_usage_limits.name: Plan Limit Usage
master.plan_usage_limits.definition: Usage percentage across configured plan limits

raw.top_products_margin.name: Top Margin Products List
raw.top_products_margin.definition: Products ranked by margin in window

raw.lowest_products_margin.name: Lowest Margin Products List
raw.lowest_products_margin.definition: Products with lowest margin in window

raw.dormant_customers.name: Dormant Customers List
raw.dormant_customers.definition: Customers with >=2 lifetime sales and none in last 60 days

raw.top_customers.name: Top Customers List
raw.top_customers.definition: Customers ranked by net revenue in window

raw.top_suppliers.name: Top Suppliers List
raw.top_suppliers.definition: Suppliers ranked by purchases total in window

raw.top_batches_expiring.name: Soonest Expiring Batches List
raw.top_batches_expiring.definition: Batches ranked by expiry date ascending

raw.largest_open_invoices.name: Largest Open Invoices List
raw.largest_open_invoices.definition: Open invoices ranked by open balance desc

raw.overdue_sales_orders.name: Overdue Sales Orders List
raw.overdue_sales_orders.definition: Open sales orders with delivery_date < today

raw.stale_proposals.name: Stale Proposals List
raw.stale_proposals.definition: Open proposals older than 14 days without update

raw.top_recipes_margin.name: Best Margin Recipes List
raw.top_recipes_margin.definition: Recipes ranked by (price - ingredient cost) / price

raw.stocktakes_top_variances.name: Stocktake Top Variances List
raw.stocktakes_top_variances.definition: Stocktake items with largest cost variance

raw.ai_anomalies_list.name: AI Metric Anomalies List
raw.ai_anomalies_list.definition: Days with values outside +/- 3 sigma of trailing baseline

raw.reorder_suggestions.name: Inventory Reorder Suggestions
raw.reorder_suggestions.definition: Products near or below safety stock threshold

raw.staff_absent_today.name: Staff Absent Today List
raw.staff_absent_today.definition: Active staff members with no check-in today
